sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: A rating in stars: chosen as a radio group, or shown, filled to the fraction an average has.

anatomy.container: A row of max stars, 2 apart.
anatomy.star: A star outline (md 20 square, sm 14): given, filled and stroked in warning; not given, stroked in muted-foreground at 40 percent. As a choice each star is a radio button padded 2, rounded by radius-mini.
anatomy.fraction: Shown, each star filled from its start to the part of it the value covers, so 3.6 fills three and three fifths.

label.does: What the stars rate: the group's name.

value.does: The stars given, from 0; shown, it may be a fraction.

onValueChange.does: Makes it a choice: called with the stars picked, or 0 when the picked count is pressed again.

hover.means: The pointer over a star of a choice: it and those before it filled at 70 percent.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a star: the focus ring around it.

disabled.means: Turned off: at the disabled opacity.

rest.note: Given; not given, muted-foreground at 40 percent.

keyboard.does: Reaches the stars given, or the first.
Gives one star more or one fewer, as a radio group moves.

star.en: {count, plural, one {# of {total} star} other {# of {total} stars}}

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
